{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "Policy requires human approval for refunds", "claims": [{"claim": "Refunds are proposals that require a human approver before any money is changed and cannot be approved automatically", "kb_id": "KB-006"}, {"claim": "A refund request must pass eligibility checks such as invoice ownership, payment status, 30‑day window, and no existing open request for the same invoice", "kb_id": "KB-006"}, {"claim": "Refund requests go through statuses like pending approval, approved, and executed", "kb_id": "KB-009"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"reply":"I understand you’d like a refund for invoices INV-0019-M4 and INV-0002-M4. According to our refund policy, refunds are proposals that require human approval before any money is changed [KB-006]. A request must be submitted and will be reviewed; we cannot process it automatically [KB-006]. You can submit a refund request through your billing portal or provide the invoice details, and our team will evaluate it within the 30‑day window after payment [KB-006]. Once approved, the refund will be executed as a separate step [KB-009].","citations":["KB-006","KB-009"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for your request. Changing from an annual Pro subscription to a monthly Starter plan is a plan change and requires authorization from an approved workspace admin [KB-014][KB-010]. A downgrade normally takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle; if you need it to start immediately, it may generate a prorated credit or charge based on the unused portion of your current period [KB-012][KB-013]. Please have an authorized admin open the billing settings, select the Starter monthly plan, review the effective date and any estimated invoice changes, and submit the request for approval [KB-012].","citations":["KB-014","KB-010","KB-012","KB-013"]}

{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "Chunks explain failed vs pending payments and how to get support to investigate.", "claims": [{"claim": "A failed payment does not increase the invoice's paid balance and should not result in a charge.", "kb_id": "KB-003"}, {"claim": "A pending payment may appear as a charge on your statement but is not yet confirmed; review the payment status.", "kb_id": "KB-003"}, {"claim": "Support can investigate the issue using the invoice ID and payment timestamp.", "kb_id": "KB-003"}, {"claim": "If an invoice remains open after you see a charge, provide the invoice ID and payment confirmation to support for review.", "kb_id": "KB-002"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "Policy and procedure for refunds are covered", "claims": [{"claim": "Refunds are only possible within 30 days of the successful payment and cannot exceed the amount paid minus any prior refunds", "kb_id": "KB-006"}, {"claim": "Support must verify that the invoice belongs to the customer, check the payment status and paid_at time, and ensure no other open refund request exists for the same invoice", "kb_id": "KB-006"}, {"claim": "Refund requests are proposals that require human approval before any money is changed", "kb_id": "KB-006"}, {"claim": "Refund status can be pending approval, approved, rejected, executed, or failed; you should ask support for the refund request reference instead of submitting a second request", "kb_id": "KB-009"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us about invoice INV-0006-M4. Our refund policy requires that the invoice belongs to your account, the payment was successful, and the request is made within 30 days of the payment timestamp [KB-006]. The refundable amount cannot exceed the unrefunded portion of the payment [KB-006]. Refunds are proposals that must be approved by a human approver before any money is changed [KB-006]. We will verify the invoice details and payment status and then submit a refund proposal for approval. You will receive an update once the review is complete.", "citations":["KB-006"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us. Refunds are only possible when the request is made within 30 days of the successful payment and the amount does not exceed the unrefunded balance [KB-006]. Our team will verify that the invoice belongs to your account, that the payment was successful, and that no other open refund request exists for this invoice [KB-006]. Because refunds require human approval, we will create a refund proposal and a reviewer will assess it before any money is returned [KB-006]. You can check the status of the request using the ticket or refund reference we will provide once the proposal is submitted [KB-009].","citations":["KB-006","KB-009"]}

{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "Chunks provide dispute review process and refund eligibility", "claims": [{"claim": "Support can review a disputed amount when given the invoice ID and the specific line item", "kb_id": "KB-004"}, {"claim": "Refunds are possible for successful payments made within 30 days of the payment timestamp", "kb_id": "KB-006"}, {"claim": "The refundable amount cannot exceed the amount paid minus any amount already refunded", "kb_id": "KB-006"}, {"claim": "Support will verify the invoice belongs to the customer, check payment status and paid_at time, and ensure the request is within the 30‑day window", "kb_id": "KB-006"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"reply":"Hello, thank you for contacting us. To investigate the duplicate charge on invoice INV-0003-M4, we need to review the invoice line items and compare them with your workspace settings, including plan, seat count, billing cycle, credits, and taxes [KB-004]. Please provide the invoice ID and the specific line item you believe is duplicated, as well as any payment confirmation you have [KB-004]. Refunds are only possible for successful payments made within 30 days of the payment date, and the amount cannot exceed the unrefunded balance [KB-006]. Once we verify the payment status and timing, we can proceed with the review. Let us know if the invoice is still open or if you have a payment receipt [KB-002].","citations":["KB-004","KB-006","KB-002"]}

{"reply":"To investigate the $20.02 charge on invoice INV-0003-M3, please compare the line items on the invoice with your workspace’s plan, seat count, billing cycle, credits, and taxes. A mid‑cycle plan change or seat adjustment can create a prorated amount, so reviewing those details helps identify the source of the charge[KB-004]. When you contact support, include the invoice ID and the specific line item you’re questioning, as the invoice ID is the safest reference for any inquiry[KB-001]. Our team will then be able to examine the disputed amount for you.", "citations":["KB-004","KB-001"]}

{"reply":"Hello, a failed payment does not increase the invoice’s paid balance and should not result in a charge. If a payment is pending it may still settle, so please check the invoice status in your billing portal. If the invoice remains open after you see a charge on your statement, provide the invoice ID (INV-0008-M4) and any payment confirmation you have so we can investigate further [KB-003][KB-002].","citations":["KB-003","KB-002"]}

{"reply":"Hello, I understand you’re waiting for a refund on invoice INV-0002-M4. Refunds are processed as proposals that must be approved by a human before any money is transferred, and the status can be pending approval, approved, or executed [KB-009][KB-006]. To check the current status of your request, please provide the support ticket or refund request reference so we can locate it, rather than submitting a second request for the same invoice [KB-009]. Also note that refunds are only possible when the request is made within 30 days of the payment date and cannot exceed the amount originally paid [KB-006].","citations":["KB-009","KB-006"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for reaching out. Our refund policy allows a refund only if the request is made within 30 days of the payment date [KB-006]. To assess your case we need to review the invoice line items for INV-0004-M1 and compare them with your workspace settings, as a mid‑cycle plan change can result in a prorated credit [KB-004]. Please provide the invoice ID and the specific line item you believe is incorrect, or reference the existing refund request ticket, so we can investigate further and determine the status of any pending refund [KB-009].","citations":["KB-006","KB-004","KB-009"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for reaching out. To look into the $20 charge on invoice INV-0004‑M1, we’ll need to compare the invoice line items with your workspace’s plan, seat count, billing cycle, credits, and taxes. Please provide the invoice ID and the specific line item you’re questioning so we can review the disputed amount [KB-004]. Note that a mid‑cycle plan or seat change can generate a prorated charge, which may explain the amount you see [KB-013]. Once we have that information, our support team can investigate further.","citations":["KB-004","KB-013"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us about the charge on invoice INV-0002-M2. To investigate the amount, we’ll compare the line items on the invoice with your plan, seat count, billing cycle, credits, and taxes as described in our guide [KB-004]. Please provide the invoice ID and, if available, the payment confirmation so we can verify whether the invoice is still open or if a pending payment is present [KB-002]. Once we have that information, our team can review the disputed charge and determine the appropriate next steps.","citations":["KB-004","KB-002"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us about the $20.02 charge on invoice INV-0001-M3. To investigate, we’ll compare the invoice line items with your workspace’s plan, seat count, and billing cycle, as unexpected amounts can result from prorated changes or credits [KB-004]. Please confirm the invoice status (open or paid) and provide any payment confirmation you have, as an open invoice indicates Nimbus has not recorded a successful payment [KB-002]. Reviewing the invoice details against your subscription will help us determine why the charge appeared [KB-001]. If this is related to a trial ending, let us know if a payment method was on file at that time [KB-016]. Once we have this information, support can examine the disputed amount.","citations":["KB-004","KB-002","KB-001","KB-016"]}

{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "Chunks provide the process for investigating duplicate charges using invoice ID and payment status.", "claims": [{"claim": "Support can investigate duplicate charges using the invoice ID and payment timestamp.", "kb_id": "KB-003"}, {"claim": "If an invoice remains open after a successful payment, provide the invoice ID and payment confirmation to support.", "kb_id": "KB-002"}, {"claim": "Check for pending or failed payments before retrying, as duplicate charges may be due to pending attempts.", "kb_id": "KB-003"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"supported":true,"conflicting":false,"reason":"Chunks provide guidance on investigating unexpected invoice amounts and how support can review disputed charges.","claims":[{"claim":"Start by reviewing the invoice line items and compare the plan, seat count, billing cycle, credits, and taxes with the workspace settings.","kb_id":"KB-004"},{"claim":"Support can review a disputed amount when you provide the invoice ID (INV-0002-M3) and the specific line item.","kb_id":"KB-004"},{"claim":"Check the billing period, plan, and any seat changes, as these can cause prorated charges.","kb_id":"KB-001"},{"claim":"Each Nimbus invoice lists the workspace, billing period, plan, seats, taxes, credits, and total, which you should verify.","kb_id":"KB-001"},{"claim":"If a plan change occurred mid‑cycle, a proration charge may appear; the exact amount is shown as a line item on the invoice.","kb_id":"KB-008"}],"conflicting_kb_ids":[]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us. Our records show that a double charge can occur when one payment is still pending while another is submitted. Please verify the status of each invoice; an open invoice indicates Nimbus has not recorded a successful payment [KB-002]. If you see a pending payment, it has not been confirmed yet and will not affect the paid balance [KB-003]. To investigate further, kindly share the invoice ID (e.g., INV-0001-M2) and any payment confirmation you received from your bank. Our team will review the invoice and payment timestamps and get back to you.","citations":["KB-002","KB-003"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us about the charge on invoice INV-0002-M3. To investigate the discrepancy we will compare the invoice line items with your workspace’s plan, seat count, billing cycle, credits and taxes, as these factors can create prorated charges or credits [KB-004]. Please provide the specific line item you believe is incorrect, or any supporting details, so we can review the invoice using the invoice ID you supplied [KB-001]. Once we have that information our team will examine the records and get back to you with our findings.", "citations":["KB-004","KB-001"]}

{"reply":"Hi, please first check the Nimbus status page for any active incidents and note the incident ID before retrying the login [KB-029]. If the status page is clear, verify that your Single Sign‑On configuration is correct; test with an administrator account and ensure you have a verified admin session available while testing to avoid lockout [KB-018]. If users are locked out and the account uses SSO, follow the identity provider’s recovery process rather than repeatedly requesting a Nimbus password reset [KB-017]. Should the issue persist after these steps, our support team will need to investigate further.","citations":["KB-029","KB-018","KB-017"]}

{"reply":"Hi, sorry to hear about the login issues. Please try the password‑reset flow; the reset email will be sent only to the address already linked to your Nimbus account and support will never ask for your current password or a one‑time code [KB-017]. If your account uses SSO, follow your identity provider’s recovery process instead of repeatedly requesting a Nimbus password reset [KB-017]. For multi‑factor authentication problems, use a saved recovery code or an existing authenticated session to update MFA; recovery codes are single‑use and should be kept offline [KB-019]. If you have no session or recovery code, an authorized workspace administrator must verify ownership before we can assist further [KB-019]. Let us know the outcome or provide any error details so we can continue troubleshooting.","citations":["KB-017","KB-019"]}

{"reply":"Please try the password‑reset flow: go to the sign‑in page, select “Forgot password”, enter your account email, and follow the link in the reset email. Check that the address is correct and look in spam or corporate filters if the email does not arrive; each new request invalidates previous links [KB-017]. If your account uses SSO, use your identity provider’s recovery process instead of requesting another Nimbus password reset [KB-017]. If the reset still fails, ask an authorized workspace administrator to verify the account address for you [KB-017].", "citations":["KB-017"]}

{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "Chunks provide troubleshooting steps for sync issues.", "claims": [{"claim": "Check the integration connection, last successful sync time, and whether the provider reports an outage", "kb_id": "KB-025"}, {"claim": "Verify that a workspace admin has installed the integration and has proper permissions", "kb_id": "KB-028"}, {"claim": "Ensure the integration is connected to the intended workspace and grant only the requested scopes", "kb_id": "KB-024"}, {"claim": "If duplicate records appear, review external object IDs and integration logs before deleting", "kb_id": "KB-026"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "KB-025 provides troubleshooting steps for sync issues.", "claims": [{"claim": "Check the integration connection, the last successful sync time, and whether the provider reports an outage; record any error and provide the integration name, affected object type, and approximate start time before attempting to reconnect.", "kb_id": "KB-025"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us. Please first verify whether there is an active incident on the Nimbus status page; if the page shows no outage, try signing in again after a short wait [KB-029]. If the problem persists, use the password‑reset flow: open the sign‑in page, select Forgot password, enter the account email, and follow the link in the reset email, checking spam and ensuring the address is correct [KB-017]. For accounts that use SSO, follow your identity provider’s recovery process instead of requesting another Nimbus password reset [KB-017]. If these steps do not resolve the issue, an authorized workspace administrator can verify the account address and further investigate [KB-017].","citations":["KB-029","KB-017"]}

{"reply":"Hi, sorry to hear about the sync issue. Please check the integration connection and note the last successful sync time, and verify whether the provider is reporting any outage [KB-025]. Record any error messages and confirm the integration is connected to the correct workspace before attempting a reconnect [KB-025]. If you are not a workspace admin, ask an admin to review your permissions, as only admins can change sync settings [KB-028]. Should the problem persist after these checks, please provide the integration name, the type of objects affected, and the approximate time the issue started so we can investigate further [KB-025].","citations":["KB-025","KB-028"]}

{"supported": true, "conflicting": false, "reason": "The chunks provide step‑by‑step troubleshooting for sync issues.", "claims": [{"claim": "Check the integration connection, the last successful sync time, and whether the provider reports an outage before retrying.", "kb_id": "KB-025"}, {"claim": "Verify the Nimbus service status page for any active incidents and record the incident ID before retrying requests.", "kb_id": "KB-029"}, {"claim": "Ensure the user has workspace admin permissions to install or modify integrations, as only admins can change sync settings.", "kb_id": "KB-028"}], "conflicting_kb_ids": []}

{"reply":"Please start by checking the Nimbus status page for any active incidents and note the incident ID and first observed time before retrying the sync [KB-029]. Next, verify the integration connection: confirm the provider name, review the last successful sync time, and ensure the correct workspace is selected in Settings → Integrations [KB-025]. If the connection appears failed, re‑connect the integration and grant only the requested scopes, making sure it is linked to the intended workspace [KB-024]. Finally, confirm that a workspace admin has reviewed the integration permissions, as only admins can modify sync mappings and may need to adjust access [KB-028]. If the issue persists after these steps, please provide the error details and timestamps for further investigation.","citations":["KB-029","KB-025","KB-024","KB-028"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us. To investigate the sync inconsistencies, please start by checking the integration connection and the last successful sync time, and confirm the provider is not reporting an outage [KB-025]. Record any error messages and verify the correct workspace is selected before reconnecting. Review the event history and external object IDs for a sample of records to see if duplicate entries were created; avoid bulk‑deleting records as a fix [KB-026]. Also ensure the integration is connected to the intended workspace and that only the required scopes were granted [KB-024]. If the issue persists, please provide the integration name, affected object type, and the approximate time the problem began so we can further assist.", "citations":["KB-025","KB-026","KB-024"]}

{"reply":"Hello, thank you for reaching out. Canceling a workspace does not automatically generate a refund; a refund request must be reviewed by our support team [KB-015]. According to our refund policy, a refund can be issued only if the payment was successful, the request is made within 30 days of the payment, and the amount does not exceed the unrefunded balance on the invoice [KB-006]. To proceed, we’ll need to verify the payment status and the date the invoice was paid. Please confirm the payment date or provide any related payment confirmation, and we’ll investigate the refund eligibility for invoice INV-0005-M1.","citations":["KB-015","KB-006"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us. An authorized workspace admin can upgrade from Starter to Pro by going to Settings → Billing → Change plan, reviewing the Pro plan’s features and seat limits, and submitting the request with the desired effective date [KB-011]. When you submit the upgrade, choose the next billing cycle as the start date so the change takes effect then and does not alter the current invoice [KB-013]. If you need any help navigating these steps, please let us know and we’ll be happy to assist.","citations":["KB-011","KB-013"]}

{"reply":"Thank you for contacting us. All refunds are proposals that require recorded human approval before any payment is changed [KB-006][KB-007]. A refund request will remain in a pending‑approval state until an approver reviews it [KB-009]. We will forward your request to the appropriate team for review; you will be notified once a decision is made. If you have a ticket or reference number for this invoice, please share it so we can locate the request [KB-009].","citations":["KB-006","KB-007","KB-009"]}
